$comment: How a "[Component Audit] <Name>:" pull request's own axe pass deviates from the default, which audits the component's stories with `--components <Name>`, writes pr-a11y-evidence/<kebab>-a11y-report.json, and requires a non-empty <kebab>-audit-evidence/ folder (top level or under test-results/) when the audit runs a spec. Read by .github/scripts/a11y-pr-contracts.mjs. Add an entry only when an audit needs a different component set, an open-state story or readiness selector, an environment variable, or a different evidence folder.
